summary: Iteration 17 — verified MarkerStudio (premium fullscreen player-marking sheet) end-to-end with no regressions. Backend: all 12 precision_engine unit tests + 9 iter16 API tests pass (21/21). Frontend: free login → /upload → drop /tmp/test_clip.webm → 'Lock onto your player' button visible → opens MarkerStudio (data-testid='marker-studio') → all 12 control testids present (ms-cancel, ms-confirm, ms-video, ms-play, ms-scrub, ms-frame-back, ms-frame-fwd, ms-mode-navigate, ms-mode-box, ms-autofind, ms-zoom-in, ms-zoom-out) → LOCK button correctly disabled before draw → mode toggle works both directions (top-left chip flips NAVIGATE ↔ MARK BOX) → mouse-drag in MARK BOX mode draws volt-green box with 4 white corner handles → LOCK becomes enabled → clicking it closes the studio and renders upload-mark-preview on UploadPage → Auto-find lazy-loads MediaPipe ObjectDetector from CDN, completes in ~3.5s on solid-green clip with 0 detections and ZERO console errors (graceful failure path confirmed) → ms-cancel closes the studio cleanly. Admin lands at /admin, premium at /dashboard. Premium seeded demo report contains NO confidence badges (High/Medium/Low Confidence). 0 JS console errors across the full studio interaction.
critical_code_review_comments: MarkerStudio.jsx is ~1059 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into sub-modules: geometry/hit-test helpers, pointer/touch gesture controller hook, the MediaPipe auto-find loader, and the JSX shell. Would also let unit tests cover the geometry helpers in isolation.
server.py still ~6413 lines (carried over from iter 16) — same modularisation feedback applies.

MediaPipe model+wasm (~9MB) is fetched from jsdelivr + storage.googleapis.com on first Auto-find click; the first invocation took ~3.5s in the test env. If users are on slow mobile networks consider preloading on UploadPage mount (low priority — current UX is acceptable since it only blocks the Auto-find affordance, not core box-draw flow).

Two harmless MediaPipe sourcemap warnings (vision_bundle_mjs.js.map missing) in the compile log — cosmetic only, can be silenced via CRA's GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false or by adding 'source-map-loader' exclusions.
